main_text.head: CAPUT XII. De potestate Excommunicandi.
IOANNES CALVINUS, GASPARI LISERO, in Lib. Epist. Col. 180.
main_text.p: NUNQUAM utile putavi, jus excommunicandi permittri singulis Pastoribus. Nam & res odiosa est, nec exemplum probabile, & facilis inde in tyrannidem lapsus, & alium usum Apostoli tradiderunt.I.
main_text.head: HIERONYMUS ZANCHIUS, in quartum praeceptum, in tractatu de Disciplina Ecclesiastica, Col. 756.

p.i: Si Ecclesia exigua sit, & non multis eruditis hominibus constans, non debet excommunicatio fieri, nisi vicinioribus consultis Ecclesiis.

page.notes: The initial N is a woodcut letter. Marginal numerals I. and II. are read as printed. The word "permittri" is printed as shown and may be a misprint for permitti; left as printed. Attribution line for Zanchius is set in roman with a bold-like capital style, rendered as a head.
